mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_trn_paid_holiday_request ( paid_holiday_request_id, holiday_type, holiday, employee_id, request_reason, request_flag ) VALUES ( #{paidHolidayRequestId}, #{holidayType}, #{holiday}, #{employeeId}, #{requestReason}, #{requestFlag} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_trn_paid_holiday_request WHERE request_flag = #{requestFlag}

SELECT request.paid_holiday_request_id,
employee.employee_id,
employee.employee_name,
CASE employee.department_id WHEN 1 THEN '営業部' WHEN 2 THEN '総務部' WHEN 3 THEN '人事部' END AS department_name,
request.holiday_type,
request.holiday,
request.request_reason
FROM tb_trn_paid_holiday_request request
INNER JOIN tb_mst_employee employee
ON request.employee_id = employee.employee_id
WHERE request.request_flag = #{requestFlag}
ORDER BY request.holiday ASC, employee.employee_id ASC, request.paid_holiday_request_id ASC
